The following is a list of patch v13.01's changes and updates to ''VALORANT''.

Full context and other dev notes about the updates may be found in the [[Patch Notes/13.01/Archive|official notes]].

==Agent Updates==
==={{ai|Iso}}===
*{{abi text|Double Tap}}
**{{ui|Buff}} Weapon reequip speed increased Fast >>> Instant
**{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: Incorrectly preventing [[fall damage]]
==={{ai|Yoru}}===
*{{abi text|Fakeout}}
**{{ui|Buff}} Mirror image equipped weapon changed from Yoru's strongest weapon >>> Yoru's last equipped weapon
*{{abi text|Gatecrash}}
**{{ui|Buff}} Tether duration increased 15s >>> 20s
*{{abi text|Dimensional Drift}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: Gaining movement speed when interacting with [[flex]]
==={{ai|Astra}}===
*General
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Bugfix: Ability cooldown timer remaining visible after ability already used
==={{ai|Clove}}===
*{{abi text|Ruse}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: Gaining an extra charge during the Buy Phase by purchasing and reselling charges
==={{ai|Cypher}}===
*{{abi text|Cyber Cage}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: Incorrectly blocking line-of-sight interactions above the cage's VFX
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Bugfix: Trajectory indicator not appearing when throwing to locations outside of Cypher's line of sight
**{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Failing to play an audio cue when enemies entered through the lower portion of the cage
*{{abi text|Spycam}}
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Bugfix: VO not playing correctly during specific actions
==={{ai|Deadlock}}===
*{{abi text|GravNet}}
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Bugfix: 3P VFX disappearing after a player disconnected and reconnected to the match
==={{ai|Gekko}}===
*{{abi text|Thrash}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Nearsight VFX persisting after Thrash destroyed by an enemy
==={{ai|Jett}}===
*{{abi text|Cloudburst}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: Able to be activated during {{abi text|Updraft}} and {{abi text|Tailwind}} animations when multiple abilities were bound to the same key
*{{abi text|Tailwind}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Unable to pick up the [[Spike]] or [[weapons]] during Tailwind
==={{ai|KAYO}}===
*{{abi text|FLASH/drive}}
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Bugfix: Missing VFX
**{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: Equip animation skip
==={{ai|Miks}}===
*{{abi text|Waveform}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: Gaining an extra charge during the Buy Phase by purchasing and reselling charges
==={{ai|Neon}}===
*{{abi text|High Gear}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Unable to pick up the [[Spike]] if sliding over it
==={{ai|Reyna}}===
*{{abi text|Dismiss}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Occasionally unable to equip [[weapons]]
==={{ai|Sage}}===
*{{abi text|Resurrection}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: Allies revived within {{abi text|Poison Cloud}} or {{abi text|Viper's Pit}} not being Nearsighted
==={{ai|Skye}}===
*{{abi text|Trailblazer}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Nearsight VFX persisting after tiger destroyed by an enemy
*{{abi text|Guiding Light}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: Gaining an extra charge during the Buy Phase by purchasing and reselling charges
==={{ai|Viper}}===
*{{abi text|Viper's Pit}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Players using [[Possession|possessive]] abilities briefly seeing through the pit
==={{ai|Veto}}===
*{{abi text|Evolution}}
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Bugfix: VO filter persisting on certain lines for the remainder of the match

==Map Updates==
===[[Abyss]]===

===[[Split]]===
*{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: [[Killjoy]]'s [[Alarmbot]] interacting with players through certain wooden covers

==Weapon Updates==
==={{wi|Outlaw}} [[Outlaw]]===
*{{ui|Nerf}} Recovery increased 0.1s >>> 0.15s after first shot
*{{ui|Nerf}} Alt fire max spread increased 0 >>> 2.25 after first shot
*{{ui|Nerf}} Recoil increased 0 >>> 4 after first shot

==Modes Updates==
===[[Competitive]]===
*Rank Manipulation Penalties
**New tools to better detect rank manipulation
**Penalties include account suspensions, rank reversions, and ranked reward reversions.
